reason: My renderer is gone and I do need someone, and a free build of one of my plans with no deposit costs me nothing but a lunch. I'd pay for one plan if it looks right, but I'm not committing to a batch until I see it.
objection: $1,500 a home is steep when I have dozens of plans and mostly reuse one render across many spec lots. Also, will they still be around in a year, and can they match my finishes?
would_change_my_mind: A per-plan or library price so I'm not paying per house, plus a sample that matches my actual finish packages.
